basics.name: Vaibhavi Nitin Lokegaonkar
basics.label: Graduate Student, Computer Science
basics.summary: Graduate student at the University of Maryland, College Park, working in the PIRL and GAMMA Labs under the guidance of Prof. Dinesh Manocha and Prof. Ramani Duraiswami. Research interests: Multimodal AI, Music Understanding, and Intelligibility.

work.name: GAMMA Lab, University of Maryland, College Park
work.summary: Curated a dataset of 1,000+ instances of non-speech sounds and music paired with multiple choice questions requiring audio-reasoning skills for DCASE2025. Actively working on music intelligibility and understanding.
highlights: Dataset creation for non-speech sounds and music

work.name: Multimodal Perception Lab, IIIT-Bangalore
work.summary: Proposed a novel video-audio embedding scheme to capture implicit expressions and dialogue intent in acting auditions. Improved state-of-the-art performance by 12%.

work.name: Adobe Research
work.summary: Developed algorithms for textual hierarchy estimation in design documents. Built GPT-based pipelines for generating contextual prompts to populate design templates.

work.name: E-Health Research Center, IIIT-Bangalore
work.summary: Built an attention-based video model for identifying self-stimulatory actions from raw videos, with 30% lower inference latency and 81% accuracy. Authored a paper published at IEEE Healthcom 2023.

education.institution: International Institute of Information Technology, Bangalore

publications.name: Introducing SSBD+ Dataset with a Convolutional Pipeline for Detecting Self-Stimulatory Behaviours
publications.summary: Proposed a convolutional pipeline for detecting self-stimulatory behaviours from videos, introducing the SSBD+ dataset.

publications.name: MMAU-Pro: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Holistic Evaluation of Audio General Intelligence
publications.summary: Comprehensive benchmark for evaluating general audio intelligence across multiple tasks. Submitted to AAAI 2026 Main Track.

projects.name: GPT-3 Implementation
projects.summary: Implemented GPT-3 architecture from scratch using PyTorch and trained on the Tiny Shakespeare dataset.

projects.name: Van Gogh Me!
projects.summary: Generated Van Gogh-style celebrity portraits using CycleGAN trained on Van Gogh paintings and CelebA dataset.
